title: Killa Strawberry Cheesecake Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Strawberry Cheesecake Nicotine Pouches offer a dessert-inspired flavour, blending the sweet taste of ripe strawberries with the creamy notes of cheesecake. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it suitable for adult users who prefer a satisfying yet balanced nicotine release. The Strawberry Cheesecake flavour provides a rich and smooth taste, delivering a long-lasting and enjoyable experience. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, offering a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Strawberry Cheesecake pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted with a focus on consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Strawberry Cheesecake offers a practical and flavoursome option for those who enjoy a dessert-inspired twist while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch.
